title: JDK G1 bug crashes with references [in]to jdk.internal.vm.FillerArray, when upgrading to 8.13.0 or 8.13.1
body:
After upgrading Elasticsearch from 8.12.2 to 8.13.0, we see random nodes failure with the following message:

